description: This file defines the TenantDetailsService interface for tenant-related operations within the Fineract platform, including methods to load a tenant by ID and to find all tenants.

classes.name: TenantDetailsService
classes.description: Interface specifying tenant-related lookup methods in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: loadTenantById
methods.description: Loads a tenant based on the provided tenant ID.

methods.name: findAllTenants
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all tenants.
